title: intel.integrity.flagged v1 payload
description: Spam or sexual-content hides of one post crossed integrity.spam_flag_rate_threshold (Tara Intelligence WP 7.4). Emitted by feed at most once per post per 24 h, in the transaction that records the flag. No hider is named: only the rate and the number of distinct accounts. Behind INTEL_EMIT_R4_EVENTS (default on). Consumer: moderation (a system-sourced case, never attributed to a user).
